name: orbit-tally-connector
description: Standalone CLI that syncs Orbit ledgers/invoices with a local Tally Prime / Tally.ERP 9 instance over its HTTP XML interface. No dependency on the Orbit app codebase.
notes: No install step needed inside connector/ when run from the Orbit monorepo checkout — `npx tsx` picks up the root's node_modules/.bin/tsx. For a fully standalone deployment (this folder copied elsewhere), run `npm install` here first.
